notes.title: Inukari - Fateful detour out now!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow critters,
its me Kai creator of Inukari.

I can't believe that I'm doing this again. But here we are.
Born from a wish to make a tiny little DLC and some polishing for the main game.
Fateful detour was created more and more to a stand alone experience.

Its fascinating to work on a video game and see how it grows and get 
personality with every little detail. That's why my focus this time was on lil' cut scenes
and smoother animations. On top of this. I wanna add these new animation for our hero
into the origin game as soon as possible. So if you own chase of deception. You may take
a look back and see what I will add for this, too.

But hey lets celebrate!
Just in time for Halloween we made it. The passionate Nakanoi_ did it again and add
a massive awesome Soundtrack within 11 blasting hits!

I'm very grateful and happy about the result.

Hope you are with us and have an amazing experience with Inukari.

So far,
stay healthy and be kind.

Your Kai Kieschnick <3
